summary: Sumter County tower known from one listing that records a 2008 auction sale for $2,000; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: The last dated entry is a 2008 auction sale. No source says whether the tower still stands.

events.note: The listing says the tower was sold at auction for $2,000.00.

corrections.proposed: not named in any source found
corrections.why: The listing gives T19S-R22E-2 as a location code. It names no agency for the tower.

evidence.supports: Listing for a tower called Wildwood in Sumter County

evidence.quote: 2008: The tower was sold at auction for $2000.00.

evidence.supports: Fire towers are sold as surplus state property when no longer needed
evidence.quote: those items are sold as surplus state property

evidence.supports: High bidder expected to dismantle and deliver the tower
evidence.quote: The high bidder is expected to dismantle and deliver the tower to its new destination.

evidence.supports: Fire towers are usually dismantled in sections
evidence.quote: Fire towers are usually dismantled in sections with the assistance of a buyer-provided crane and loaded on a buyer-provided flatbed and hauled away.

evidence.supports: Sale as surplus is the state's process
evidence.quote: When the Florida Forest Service decides that vehicles, fire towers and other equipment are no longer needed, those items are sold as surplus state property.

sources.title: Surplus Equipment and Fire Towers
sources.publisher: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services

notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific source is a short listing: a name, Sumter County, a location code and one dated sale entry. The listing does not name the state; Florida is taken from the site's Florida list. Two searches turned up topo-map listings that give the name and coordinates only, and nothing on history. The story body is about 142 words, above the 120-word floor. The FDACS sentences describe the current sale process, not the 2008 sale. The brief's agency field holds a township code, not an agency.
